title: SSC MTS 2023 Tier-1 Art & Culture PART-1

questions.question: _____________ is one of the most important festivals of Kamakhya temple of Guwahati. It is held every year during the monsoon (mid-June) season, when the temple is closed for three days for tantric rites.
The most famous of all Jain festivals, Mahamastakabhisheka is performed every 12 years at the Digambara sacred complex at _______________ in Karnataka.
One of the prominent festivals celebrated in ____________ is the ‘Me-Dum-Me-Phi’, i.e., the ancestor worship festival.

‘Chapchar Kut’ is a festival from the state of _________. It is celebrated during March after the completion of the most arduous task of Jhum operation i.e., jungle clearing (clearing of the remnants of burning).
‘Losoong’ festival, celebrated by the tribal community in ___________, is usually the time when the farmers rejoice and celebrate their harvest.
Which festival brings out the fusion rich culture of Chhattisgarh and Odisha?
Janmashtami is a Hindu festival that celebrates the birth (janma) of the god, Krishna on the eighth (ashtami) day of the dark fortnight of the Hindu month of _____________.
Paryushana Parva is a festival of which of the following communities?

‘Atla Taddi’, a festival celebrated by married and unmarried women alike to seek the blessings of Devi Gauri for a long and happy married life and a suitable groom, respectively, is celebrated in ____________.
The Konark Dance Festival (KDF) has been held at Konark since 1986 between ___________ every year.
The Nuakhai festival of ______________ is observed on Panchami Tithi (fifth day) of the lunar fortnight of Bhadrava (August-September), the day after Ganesh Chaturthi.

Popular since ancient eras for the trading of livestock, ___________, which is a month-long event, takes place on the auspicious occasion of Kartik Purnima in the month of November near Harihar Nath temple.
The sal tree assumes great significance in a number of tribal communities scattered across eastern India. For instance, ________ festival is celebrated in honour of the tree in Jharkhand.
According to Sikh literature, the birth anniversary of Guru Nanak Dev is celebrated on the full moon day of the Indian lunar month ____________.
________________is celebrated in Jharkhand immediately after Diwali on the new moon day in the honour of cattle.
In which of the following States was the first Janjatiya Khel Mahotsav held?
Buddha Purnima is marked on a full moon day in the Hindu month of ____________.
Shri Jagannathji Mela is held at _______.
The Madhavpur fair is held at _________.
Dree Utsav is celebrated in the state of ____________.
Which state of India is associated with the famous thunderstorms ‘Kaal Baisakhi’?
The advent of the spring season has the _____________ villages filled with the melodious singing of ‘Bagurumba’.
To mark the celebration of Gandhi Jayanti, the _____________ celebrates it as International Day of Non-Violence.
questions.option_2: South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation

questions.question: The world’s largest camel fair is held in which of the following cities?
Rajgir Mahotsav is a beautiful representation of history, religion, art and culture. It is a three-day celebration in ____________.
